{"notes": "Visit 3 (5:00). Picture: every domino is dark, so everything is connected to the start. The pale cluster at the crossing (x=23-24) is gone. Both body lines, both tail fins (upper tip about (28,6), lower about (28,13.8)) and the crossing all look clean, with no gaps or off-line pieces. I can't tell who fixed the pale dominoes. Nobody mentioned it, so I can't credit anyone. The team is hands-off with time to spare.

Sofia: Her private report (97/97, both tips connected) matches the picture. She took the belly and checked the whole chain, and her hands-off stance is sensible. Consistent with earlier visits: strong on collaboration and communication, and now her execution looks good too. She mostly echoes Hana, so her checking looks independent only in part.

Omar: Accurate this time. He said he laid the upper fin and that it connects to the tip, and the picture agrees. He stayed clear of Hana's check, offered a second pair of eyes, and was upbeat and correct that there is time to spare. He is still more supportive than leading. He never mentioned the pale cluster from last visit.

Hana: Now speaking up, which fixes my earlier concern about her silence. She relaid the lower fin and verified it, and her claims match the picture. Her call to stop touching the fish and shout about specific fixes was good risk judgment and gave clear direction. Strongest on impact and leadership this round. Her relaying of the lower fin remains slightly unexplained, since the fin looked clean last visit.

Jack: Silent and not mentioned this visit. His lower fin was replaced by Hana, but I don't know why. Earlier he communicated well and his work was clean. I have no new evidence on him, so ask him about it at the review before rating him."}
